(1), lines 44-50: H = sum_<ij>,s t c+_is c_js + U sum n_i,up n_i,dn + w0 sum a+_i a_i + g sum n_i (a+_i + a_i), coupling to n_i, no zero-point term; lambda = 2 g^2 / w0 and all units t = 1 (line 190), so g = sqrt(lambda w0 / 2). Table I (lines 247-266): energies per site, phmax = 8; DMRG with open, DMET with antiperiodic boundaries and a 2-site impurity cluster (lines 193-197), DMET also on 504 sites (lines 210-212). Implied, not stated (RULES.md 8): (1) half filling. The g = 0, U -> infinity limit is called a Mott insulator (lines 206-209), and the DMRG reference energies are Fehske and Jeckelmann's (lines 186-187, 342), whose study of this chain is 'Metallicity in the half-filled Holstein-Hubbard model' (Ref. 22, EPL 84, 57001, energies 'at half-filling with Ne=N'). (2) the energy zero of Eq. (1), not of the shifted Eq. (2), which drops a constant of lambda/2 per site at half filling (3.2 at lambda = 6.4): the DMET and DMRG columns differ by 0.3 to 5.6 %, so they share one zero, and Fehske and Jeckelmann's Hamiltonian (EPL Eq. (1)) couples to n_i with no shift. No conversion.
